items.title: MECH-440 armed-stack falsifier at the raised candidate-diversity floor (708b design, class floor=action_dim, V3-EXQ-949 yoked divergence)
items.note: GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is committed_class_entropy_fraction_of_ceiling at a RAISED support_preserving_min_first_action_classes (=action_dim=5, vs 708b's hardcoded 2), combined with V3-EXQ-949-style yoked per-tick committed-action divergence + authority_rel_deviation_mean. Checked 708/708a/708b manifests: all record only the pre-commit-shape/class-entropy scalar AT THE DEFAULT FLOOR (2 classes); none combine a raised floor with a yoked measurement. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> run. Step 2.5b re-derive brake: 0 substrate_ceiling-category autopsies for MECH-440 in the corpus (2026-08-28 check) -- NOT braked. Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap gate: two OPEN corrupting substrate_queue entries name files this driver imports at module level -- mode-governance-engagement (not in this driver's causal path, no mode-governance knob enabled) and contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py; potentially in path via E1 but applies identically to every arm and interacts with neither the injection-site nor authority factor, biasing toward the null not a false positive) -- both carved out per the 949/947 drivers' identical precedent. Two OPEN degrading entries (mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism, SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING) also overlap causal_grid_world.py/agent.py/config.py -- noted, non-blocking. DESIGN: V3-EXQ-708b's design (same 3 arms A0_OFF/ARM_TEMP/ARM_NOISE_SINGLE, same matched SOTA conversion stack incl. use_modulatory_selection_authority=True, same 6 seeds, same P0=100/P1=50 phased training) with support_preserving_min_first_action_classes raised from 2 to action_dim, PLUS the V3-EXQ-949 yoked-pair/private-RNG-stream mechanism for P2 (reference=A0_OFF's trained agent drives the env; ARM_TEMP/ARM_NOISE_SINGLE's trained agents step on the identical observation sequence) so the run measures whether a lever that moves the pre-commit distribution shape ever reaches the COMMITTED action -- closing 708b's own honest limit ("the shape/entropy scalar cannot tell moved-the-shape from moved-the-outcome"). ARMED-CONVERSION P1 (mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 0.9 * action_dim, every arm) and P2 (authority_rel_deviation_mean > 0.05, lever-bearing arms) are MEASURED readiness gates, not assumptions; VACUITY RULE self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue if either is unmet, per V3-EXQ-949's confirmed strict-AND precedent. CEILING-HEADROOM CHECK on A0_OFF (fraction-of-ceiling < 0.90) gates the falsifying branch. PASS: ARM_NOISE_SINGLE's committed_class_entropy_fraction_of_ceiling strictly above ARM_TEMP's AND its yoked divergence vs A0_OFF clears 0.02, both on >=2/3 of >=4 divergent seeds. SECONDARY state-conditioning/self-annealing checks (per-state noise magnitude covaries with state; per-parameter sigma anneals with confidence) are NOT measured by this run -- recorded honestly as secondary_checks_measured=false; a PASS here establishes propagation only, leaving two-thirds of MECH-440 untested. SCOPE: does not refute MECH-439 F-dominance or ARC-110's intrinsic-ceiling finding; both may still hold at a raised floor -- a null here is a genuine result for the first time. SMOKE: --dry-run PASS (run twice, under the ID renames forced by live concurrent-session ID collisions on V3-EXQ-953 and V3-EXQ-954 -- see completion_note). validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 warnings). INSTRUMENT CONTROL self-yoke divergence = 0.000000 for all 3 arms (RNG isolation verified). z_goal_stream: writer_calls=273, active_frac=0.000 -- no writer defect (benefit gate correctly never opened on this tiny/short smoke). estimated_minutes calibrated directly from V3-EXQ-708b's OWN landed manifest (elapsed_seconds=58218.87 = 16.2h for the identical arms/seeds/P0/P1/P2 episode budget on ree-worker-1), +~40% for this design's added yoked-3-runner P2 pass + self-yoke control checks. Raised as GFLAG-0072 (evidence_discrepancy), 2026-08-28; proposal EXP-0593 / backlog_id EVB-0651 in manual_proposals.v1.json.

items.title: MECH-439 F-variance-share under F-demotion, rollout-clamp bug-fix re-run of V3-EXQ-936
items.note: Bug-fix letter, not a new hypothesis (same question/claim as V3-EXQ-936). V3-EXQ-936 (2026-08-17) measured this exact question and got a corrupted answer: SD-056's online E2 contrastive training was armed on every arm but the E2 rollout-norm clamp (e2_rollout_output_norm_clamp_enabled) that V3-EXQ-689i paired it with was never declared in this lineage's baseline module despite claiming '689i parity'. Without the clamp, world_forward_contrastive_loss rollout magnitudes overflowed to 1e16-1e18 (confirmed independently on V3-EXQ-569e's identical code path), saturating f_variance_share to 1.0 in all 8 cells and destroying the load-bearing C2 criterion. failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-936_2026-08-18 confirmed this as an INSTRUMENT defect (severity corrupting, category standard/non_contributory, not substrate_ceiling) and named the fix: enable the clamp with 689i's own parameters. Fix applied in experiments/_lib/baselines/mech439_f_variance_share.py CONFIG_FLAGS (fires on every arm); does NOT flip the REEConfig class default (still False globally per the autopsy's explicit veto of that as a separate governance decision). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): the corrected readout is not recoverable from any existing manifest -- V3-EXQ-936 is the only prior run of this question and its own reading is the corrupted one this corrects. Step 2.5b re-derive brake: MECH-439 count=12 (13 incl. 936 itself), threshold-triggering, but the most recent counted autopsy (936's own) names the required upstream substrate as SD-056 with status=implemented (clamp mechanism BUILT+VALIDATED, already exercised for real by V3-EXQ-689i) -- brake RELEASES per Step 2.5b's release condition; only the autopsy's separate corpus-wide WARN lint recommendation remains unbuilt and is orthogonal to this run's validity (that lint now exists and was exempted here via SD056_ROLLOUT_CLAMP_EXEMPT, documented false-positive: it cannot see through the CONFIG_FLAGS kwargs-splat indirection). Step 2.5c: substrate_queue.json SD-056 status=implemented reads as CLOSED under the gate's own text-match rule (only the corpus lint sub-task remains open, not the clamp mechanism this run applies), so no block. SMOKE: --dry-run PASS, no crash; critically the nonf_variance_nondegenerate precondition (the exact statistic the overflow annihilated in 936, var(non-F)/var(F)) measured ~9.3 at dry-run scale vs 936's near-zero collapse -- direct evidence the fix works. validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 warnings after exemption). estimated_minutes taken directly from V3-EXQ-936's own landed manifest (elapsed_seconds=6299.6s=~105min on ree-cloud-2), +~10 min margin -- compute shape (P0/P1/seeds/arms) is unchanged by the clamp.
